data.narrative:
MBRYONICS is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised €17.5M+ to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a defined peer set of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, Skyryse) alongside 6 public space and aerospace comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression anchors to the €17.5M total raised, applying a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier to imply €33M. The Peer-Median method applies the valuation median of €1.6B across the four private peers, with a range spanning €1.1B (Skyryse) to €8.0B (Sierra Space). Public-comp anchoring is not applicable; the sector median P/S multiple is 24.6x across the six public tickers, but MBRYONICS' revenue is not on file, precluding a revenue-multiple approach.

The triangulated valuation range spans €28M (low) to €1.9B (high), with a median implied value of €842M. This wide dispersion reflects meaningful uncertainty: the stage-progression method suggests substantially lower valuation than peers, while peer-median valuation clusters at the €1.1B–€2.0B range. Key uncertainties include the company's actual revenue trajectory relative to comparables and the appropriate stage-adjustment discount for Series B versus later-stage peer companies. Additional disclosure of financial metrics would narrow this range materially.
